column1: # Independent oracle for parser construction and rule references (#845). UTF8 hex, ~ = empty.
# Grammar, built by every construction variant in ParserConstructionParityTest.java and
#   0 Root      ::= Item '!' | Item '?' | Missing | MATCH_ONLY(Item) Item '#'   (Missing is unregistered)
#   4 NotProbe  ::= NOT(Leaf)            (Classic invert source; Java custom AbstractPropagatableSource)
# kind/invert are the Classic arguments of the root call. failureCP is the farthest failure
# offset, or the reached offset when nothing failed (0 under DETAILED_ON_FAILURE, which records
# nothing in a direct context). ruleStack is the
# failure stack (outermost first, rule@startCP) and is only recorded under DETAILED/AUTO.
# original = Parsed.getOriginalTokens(); committed = root tokens; leaves = retained terminal tokens.
# A Rust rule node has no Java counterpart (a Java rule is the combinator itself), so Rust reads
# original from the rule's expression node, as classic_memo.rs does.
